experience.summary: Leading an engineering team of 8 control software and automation engineers. Directing foresight studies, machine automation architecture, Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 & Siemens TIA Portal implementations, 6-axis robotics integration, and deterministic fieldbus communications across high-availability manufacturing lines. Enforcing SDLC compliance, DFM, FMEA, code reviews, and cross-functional hardware bringup.

Maintained and optimized high-precision automated manufacturing equipment for EGR (Exhaust Gas Recirculation) and Turbocharger systems. Handled maintenance, rapid troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis (5-Why, KAIZEN) for PLCs, HMIs, and robotic workcells, minimizing unplanned downtime on high-volume production lines.

Responsible for preventive and corrective maintenance of multi-station automated automotive switch assembly lines. Executed sensor calibration, fieldbus diagnostics, and line stabilization for high-volume Tier-1 OEM deliverables.

Over 4 years of end-to-end development, programming, commissioning, and on-site deployment of Special Purpose Machines (SPMs). Programmed PLCs (Structured Text, Ladder, FBD) across Beckhoff, Siemens, and Mitsubishi platforms. Integrated industrial robotics, servo motion axes, pneumatic systems, and AOI machine vision cameras for marquee automotive clients including Maruti Suzuki, Honda, UNO Minda, Spark Minda, Lumax, Padmini VNA, and Hella.
